bio.text: Mario Diaz-Balart represents Florida's 26th Congressional District in the U.S. House and, according to his official biography, is serving his 12th term; he was first elected to Congress in 2002.
Before joining the U.S. House he served in both chambers of the Florida State Legislature.
He was born on September 25, 1961, in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, studied political science at the University of South Florida, and lives in Miami.
